name: hcme-after-sales
//: Every script calls its tool through `node node_modules/...` rather than by name. The project directory is called Parts&Service, and npm puts node_modules/.bin on PATH for a shell that treats the ampersand as a command separator — so a bare `vite` or `tsc` dies with 'Service\node_modules\.bin\' is not recognized. dev and build were already written this way; typecheck and check were not, and had never run.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
